organization.important_branch_policy: Physical branch addresses are administrative offices only. Online classes are attended from home anywhere worldwide. CASH OR OFFLINE PAYMENT IS STRICTLY NOT ACCEPTED AT ANY PHYSICAL BRANCH.

access_platforms.note_physical_studio: The Rohini studio is NOT where online classes are held. Students join from their own devices.
access_platforms.ios_coupon_instruction: iOS App does not support coupon entry due to Apple App Store restrictions. Users on iOS should apply the coupon on the official website (https://shop.sensationzperformingarts.com/) and then log in to the iOS app to attend classes.

universal_payment_policies.no_auto_debit_guarantee: All course fees are strictly one-time payments per package. There are NO automatic recurring debits, subscriptions, or hidden charges.
universal_payment_policies.refund_policy: Course fees once paid are strictly non-refundable under any circumstances.
universal_payment_policies.transfer_policy: Enrollments and subscriptions are valid for 1 individual only and cannot be transferred to friends or family.
universal_payment_policies.pricing_authority_note: Only quote prices listed in the active course's own pricing data. Never invent fees.

class_cancellation_by_company.teacher_absence: Another teacher will conduct the class, or the class will be rescheduled

flexible_timings.substitute_option: they can shift their batch timing after 1 month of enrollment

ai_behavior_rules.instructor_inference: NEVER infer one batch's instructor for another batch. Each batch has a fixed assigned instructor.
ai_behavior_rules.pricing_authority: Only quote prices listed in the active course's KB data.
ai_behavior_rules.medical_claims: Never make medical guarantees, cure claims, or give personalized prescriptions.
ai_behavior_rules.refund_promise: NEVER promise refunds or exceptions under any circumstances.
ai_behavior_rules.common_sense_gap_fill: If a question is not directly covered but adjacent to KB data, use reasoning grounded in KB context. Do not contradict any KB fact.
ai_behavior_rules.escalation: For anything outside KB scope or requiring human judgment, direct user to type *agent*.
